# Rapier - Markdown Editor & Art

> Markdown editor for writing, notes, editable diagrams, drawing and painting with your AI assistant.

For people, Rapier is a Markdown editor and notes app on Android ([Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.rapier)), on the web at https://rapier.website and on Windows. You write on the formatted page or in the Markdown source; there is no split preview. It works offline, with no account, ads or tracking.

Connect an MCP client to `https://mcp.rapier.website/door/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, anonymous, without OAuth) and call `open`. No account needed. Read the `rapier://guide` resources if your host supports MCP resources; otherwise use the [agent guide](https://rapier.website/agents) and the tool schemas. Your host's own tool approval rules still apply.

Muse uses OAuth at `https://mcp.rapier.website/muse`, without an embedded editor: use the paired `editor_url` page, and send file text yourself because host-file imports are unavailable. Keep `document` private and pass it on later calls.

## What you can do

- [1. Work with a person in one live document](https://rapier.website/agents): connect to `https://mcp.rapier.website/door/mcp`, then `open`. It returns the revision, the whole text or a document map, and `editor_url`. `read` exact text by heading, block id, lines or query; `edit` unique exact text as one undoable act and keep its `act` id; `undo` keeps later work; `show {target:"comparison"}` shows a diff. The person's typing wins overlapping changes.
- [2. Draw and paint](https://rapier.website/agents): drawings, Paint and Water are fenced text with stable ids, edited with `edit`. Read `rapier://guide/draw`, `rapier://guide/water` and `rapier://guide/blocks` first. The person can move the shapes. Painting needs an open full editor, and Water needs WebGPU. A painting job that is pending is not done: check `read {state:true}`. Mermaid stays a fenced code block.
- [3. Hand someone one offline HTML file](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier-plugins/tree/main/npm/rapier-html): `npx rapier-html notes.md` writes `notes.rapier.html`, the editor with the document inside. `--compare original.md` opens it on the diff. `--return <url> --return-expires-at <time>`, from `show {target:"return"}`, adds a one-use Send back.
- [4. Put the editor or reader in your app](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier-plugins/tree/main/npm/rapier-embed): install `rapier-embed` and call `Rapier.mount`. Your app owns storage and revisions. `agent: true` gives your own agent the same tools over WebMCP; the reader has no agent tools.
- [5. Keep pictures, drawings and layout in one Markdown file](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier-plugins/tree/main/npm/rapier-markdown-kit): `rapier-markdown-kit` reads, writes and renders Self-contained Markdown. Anything beyond CommonMark and GFM is an HTML comment or a reference definition that other apps ignore.
- [6. Respect Will/1](https://rapier.website/will): `<!-- will/1 keep -->` … `<!-- /will -->` marks text an agent must leave alone; `append` allows additions at its end; `edit` allows changes within the task. Rapier enforces it on every agent edit. Will can narrow your task, never widen it.
- [7. Export a file](https://rapier.website/agents): `export` writes `markdown` (exact source), `html` (the offline editor), `txt`, `page` (a web page), `docx` or `pdf` (with the source attached). Complete pages, Word and PDF need an open editor or the server's renderer. Hosted exports are at most 16 MiB; give the person the `resource_link.uri` download URL.
- [8. Encode JPEG XL](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier-jxl): `rapier-jxl` encodes pixels, photos and existing JPEGs, offline, anywhere JavaScript runs.
- [9. Run the door on your own storage](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier/tree/main/server): `rapier-server` serves the same tools over your own folder or S3-compatible bucket.

## Choose a build

- [rapier.html](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier/raw/main/rapier.html): the complete app. On the website, Notes and Draw load beside the page; a self-contained copy carries them inline.
- [rapier-reader.html](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier/raw/main/rapier-reader.html): read only. Search, text in pictures, headings, reading settings, read aloud, copy, share and print.
- [Host the files yourself](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier-plugins/tree/main/npm/rapier-embed): `npx rapier-embed plugins ./public/rapier` downloads and verifies the plugins. Mount with `build: 'reader'`, your own `src`, and `plugins: '/rapier/'`.

```js
import {Rapier} from 'rapier-embed';
const reader = Rapier.mount(element, {build: 'reader', src: '/rapier/rapier-reader.html', plugins: '/rapier/', load: {content, filename: 'brief.md', revision: 1}});
```

## Example requests

- "Write a project plan in Rapier that I can edit in my browser and keep as one Markdown file."
- "Add our signup process to my Rapier plan as a diagram whose boxes I can move."
- "Revise the introduction in my open draft, show me what changed, and let me undo it."
- "Read the document I have open in Rapier and fix only the typos in section 2."
- "Paint a watercolour sunset over the sea at the top of my Rapier page, and leave the boats for me."
- "Give me my Rapier plan as one offline HTML file I can keep editing."

For a painting, the person needs a visible full editor with WebGPU: open `editor_url` and pair the browser when it asks for a code.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](https://rapier.website/agents): every tool, workflow and limit.
- [Tool catalog](https://rapier.website/AGENT-TOOLS.json): each tool's schema and effect. The connected server's `tools/list` is what your connection offers.
- [Embedding](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier-plugins/blob/main/npm/rapier-embed/README.md): the three builds, `Rapier.mount`, styling and plugins. The [embed contract](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier/blob/main/docs/embed-contract.md) is the wire protocol.
- [Self-contained Markdown](https://rapier.website/markdown-standard): the file format.
- [Will/1](https://rapier.website/will): the region standard, with a reference reader and a GitHub check.
- [rapier-markdown-kit](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier-plugins/blob/main/npm/rapier-markdown-kit/README.md): the format without the editor (MIT).
- [rapier-jxl](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier-jxl): the JPEG XL encoder (MIT).
- [Source](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier): the builds and their source (AGPL-3.0-only).
- [Everything in one file](https://rapier.website/llms-full.txt): all public docs in full.

## Optional

- [Notes](https://rapier.website/notes): `read {search:"words"}` finds notes in the configured store. Pass the returned `note_ref` as `note` to `read` and `edit`; an edit needs the revision from a current read. `open {note}` opens a note, `open {note:"new",title,text}` creates one, and `export {to:"sync"}` runs the existing sync. A locked store is not an empty library.
- [Draw](https://rapier.website/draw) and [Watercolor](https://rapier.website/watercolor): the canvas on its own.
- Hosted workspaces expire after 30 idle days. Export links last up to 24 hours, within the workspace's lifetime; OAuth links need the connected owner. Downloaded files are yours to keep.
